subject: Audit log storage class pricing & KMS hot-path fee — request to accelerate migration credit
messages:
From: Jill Park <jill.park@medguardian.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com
Date: 2026-11-19T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Clarify: audit log storage classes + KMS hot-path fee and migration credit

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the latency benchmarks. Before Legal/Procurement opens an SOW, a couple of quick commercial clarifications so we can scope internal approval:

- Audit log storage: you list "hot", "warm", and "cold" tiers in the quote. Can you confirm per-GB/month for each (including retention tiers >1 year)? We have a heavy tail of infrequent queries and want to decide on lifecycle rules.
- KMS/HSM: the pricing sheet shows a "hot-path" add-on for high-frequency envelope operations. Is that metered per-op, per-seat, or a blended monthly slab?
- Migration credit: because we have to ingest ~9TB of historical logs, our CFO is asking whether Redwood will accelerate any onboarding/migration credit or amortize it over 12 vs. 36 months.

I've attached a small sample of our log profile (auditlog_usage_sample.csv). If you can send a short note with 2–3 packaging options (pilot vs. scale) and an indicative crediting approach, procurement can route to Legal.

Appreciate the quick turn — we need to present to our CFO on Monday morning (PST).

Best,
Jill Park
Head of IT Ops, MedGuardian Health
---
Attachment: auditlog_usage_sample.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com
To: Jill Park <jill.park@medguardian.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodai.com, naomi_feldman@redwoodai.com
Date: 2026-11-19T12:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Clarify: audit log storage classes + KMS hot-path fee and migration credit

Jill — thanks for the sample and the context. Looping in Laura (pricing) and Naomi (account finance) so we can get a concise set of options back to you by EOD. Quick answers up front:

1) Audit log tiers (indicative):
   - Hot: $0.045/GB/month (replicated, low-latency queries, <30d)
   - Warm: $0.018/GB/month (SSD-backed, lifecycle-triggered, 30–365d)
   - Cold: $0.006/GB/month (object-backed, retrieval cost applies, >365d)
   - We can tighten these for a commit; the attached pricing_scenarios.xlsx will show slab pricing for 1TB/10TB/100TB.

2) KMS/HSM hot-path: two options:
   - Metered per-op: $0.0008/operation (suitable for low-volume envelopes)
   - Hot-path slab: $1,200/month for up to 75M ops, then $0.0006/op overage (recommended for steady high throughput)

3) Migration credit approaches we can offer (short):
   - Accelerated onboarding credit: one-time credit equal to 20% of first 12 months of audit log storage costs, applied to first invoice.
   - Amortized credit: same dollar value amortized over 36 months (lower monthly impact).
   - Pilot uplift: for a paid pilot (3 months), we can offer 40% of migration credit upfront upon SOW signature; remainder remining post-production.

Requested next steps: if you can confirm expected committed long-term storage (approx TB) and whether you prefer upfront vs. amortized accounting treatment, we will prepare a short addendum to the quote and a draft SOW.

I'll follow up internally with a recommended concession path (Laura/Naomi, any immediate concerns on the %/accounting treatment?).

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: pricing_scenarios.xlsx (Excel, 58KB)

From: laura_bennett@redwoodai.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwoodai.com, ben_carter@redwoodai.com
Date: 2026-11-20T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: internal: recommended concession & SOW language for MedGuardian

Karthik — reviewing the numbers. Quick internal take (naomi/ben please weigh in):

- Migration credit: offer the Accelerated onboarding credit (20% of first 12 months) but make it conditional on a 12-month minimum commitment at the quoted storage slabs. For CFOs that want amortization, we can allow 36-month amortization but require SOW annex to state the total credit value and monthly amortization schedule.
- KMS hot-path: recommend the slab option for MedGuardian based on the sample (peak ops align with slab threshold). Price the slab as $1,000/month if they sign a 24-month commitment (trade for a lower monthly credit).
- Audit log tiers: allow a 10% variance floor on actual usage in months 1–3, after which true-ups apply. This keeps the pilot predictable.

SOW language: I'll draft a single-paragraph addendum that enumerates the credit, the commitment term, and true-up cadence. Attach the SOW draft and mark placeholders for commitment TB and effective credit schedule.

Naomi — any regulatory/finance blockers for accelerating 20% upfront vs amortized?

Laura
VP Pricing, Redwood Inference

From: Jill Park <jill.park@medguardian.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com, laura_bennett@redwoodai.com
Cc: Mark Chen <m.chen@medguardian.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T17:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Clarify: audit log storage classes + KMS hot-path fee and migration credit

Thanks Karthik and Laura — this is exactly what we needed. A couple of quick clarifications before I route to CFO:

- We can commit to a 12-month minimum at the 10TB slab for the pilot->scale path.
- For accounting reasons they prefer upfront credits applied to the first invoice if possible. If Redwood can do the 20% onboarding credit against invoice #1, procurement will greenlight the SOW today.

If you can send the SOW addendum and a redlined sample with the invoice language, I will circulate internally. Once we have that the DocuSign link is fine.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — attaching our procurement contact details so Legal can kick off review.

Best,
Jill Park
Head of IT Ops, MedGuardian Health
